shortThesis: CivicState is a validation-first paid civic letter workflow, not yet an investible pitch.
adoptionRationale: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record
summary: Root soul upgraded from thin/missing files into a candidate business plan with explicit evidence, assumptions, financial model, anti-plan, roadmap, and decision log.

sourcesUsed.use: business model, pricing philosophy, unit economics, reserve, roadmap intent
customer, validation gates, constraints, open decisions
submission, moderation, audit, and queue behavior
registry watchlist constraint, workspace-only rule, scrutiny gaps

methods: Read existing planning and implementation files.
Separated repository evidence from market assumptions.
Used bottom-up revenue scenarios from repo-authored plan instead of external TAM claims.
Created a buildable validation roadmap tied to BUSINESS.md headings.

thesisCurrent.claim: A narrow paid workflow may monetize civic letter research, drafting, targeting, and delivery.
thesisCurrent.honesty: [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; assumption: willingness to pay is unproven]

registryContext.note: Personal/research asset, not near-term investible BOS unless operator confirms business intent.

customerDefinition.primary: U.S. resident with a concrete civic concern who wants government action but does not want to research law, officials, drafting, and delivery manually.

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up validation ladder, not external TAM.

stages.name: break-even wedge
stages.build: 25 paid submissions x $15 average order value = $375 monthly revenue

stages.name: month 3 scenario
stages.build: 50 paid submissions x $15 average order value = $750 monthly revenue

stages.name: month 6 scenario
stages.build: 120 paid submissions x $16 average order value = $1,920 monthly revenue

stages.name: month 12 scenario
stages.build: 400 paid submissions x $18 average order value = $7,200 monthly revenue

stages.name: month 24 scenario
stages.build: 1,200 paid submissions x $20 average order value = $24,000 monthly revenue

marketSizing.residualGap: External market data must be sourced when network access is available.

financialModel.reconciliation: Revenue table in BUSINESS.md uses submissions x AOV, then subtracts modeled COGS, fees, and fixed costs.

competition.name: Resistbot
competition.thesis: Low-friction constituent messages; CivicState differentiates on researched citations.

competition.name: Change.org
competition.thesis: Petition hosting; CivicState differentiates on direct letter delivery.

competition.name: LegalZoom
competition.thesis: Document preparation; CivicState stays civic-specific and non-legal-advice.

competition.name: Quorum
competition.thesis: Enterprise advocacy software; CivicState targets individuals.

competition.name: VoterVoice
competition.thesis: Organization-led advocacy; CivicState targets individual resident jobs.

goToMarket.primary: SEO from opt-in public campaign pages.
goToMarket.secondary: Operator-sourced private beta and social sharing after privacy review.

killReasons: Users may not pay despite liking the concept.
Government deliverability may fail and destroy the paid promise.
Legal-adjacent and defamation-risk submissions may overwhelm moderation.
The moat is weak until volume creates directory, citation, and SEO assets.
Registry says the asset may be personal/research rather than near-term investible.
risksAntiPlan.honesty: [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; .planning/GENESIS.md; dispatch brief; assumption: market risks unvalidated]

holes: No live revenue or traffic evidence in repo.
No external market sizing due workspace-only run.
Operator intent and project identity conflict unresolved.
No observed deliverability, conversion, or official response metrics.
mitigations: Run beta cohort with paid checkout.
Instrument deliverability and bounce metrics by domain.
Source external market data in a network-enabled pass.
Get operator ruling on CivicState versus brooks-history identity.
residualRisks: Willingness to pay remains the central unknown.
Compliance burden may exceed one-operator model.
SEO may not compound fast enough to support acquisition.

assumptionLedger.assumption: Residents will pay $5 to $25 for a civic letter campaign.
Postmark plus domain controls can achieve government deliverability.
assumptionLedger.test: Measure inbox placement, bounces, spam complaints, and replies.

assumptionLedger.assumption: Fixed prices preserve the margin floor.
assumptionLedger.test: Compare actual token, delivery, refund, and review costs per package.

roadmapBuildableShape.items: Seven single-worker checkbox items tied to BUSINESS.md headings.

honestyLabels.rule: Repo/dispatch-backed facts are evidence; external market claims are assumptions.

freshness.status: stale planning corrected by current repo read
surpriseSpikes: Dispatch project id differs from repo/product identity.
Existing-state audit says no app code existed, but current repo has app code.
Legacy roadmap says all phases complete while root soul files were absent.

authority.upgradeRule: Only operator merge upgrades authority; this file does not claim adopted status.
